classes.label: eg-bl-col
classes.css: display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 1.25rem; width: 100%; max-width: 52rem; margin-inline: auto; padding: 0;

classes.label: eg-bl-titulo
classes.css: font-size: clamp(2.125rem, 4.4vw, 3.5rem); line-height: 1.06; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.03em; color: var(--eg-papel);

classes.label: eg-bl-meta
classes.css: display: flex; flex-direction: row; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 0 1.25rem; padding: 0;

classes.label: eg-bl-prosa
classes.css: display: block; width: 100%; max-width: 46rem; margin-inline: auto; padding: 0;

classes.label: eg-bl-autor
classes.css: display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-rows: auto; gap: 0.25rem 1.25rem; align-items: center; width: 100%; max-width: 46rem; margin: clamp(3rem, 6vw, 4.5rem) auto 0; padding: 1.75rem; border-radius: 1.25rem; background-color: var(--eg-niebla); @media(--mobile) { grid-template-columns: 1fr; padding: 1.5rem; }

classes.label: eg-bl-autor-sim
classes.css: display: block; grid-row: span 3; width: 3.5rem; height: 3.5rem; padding: 0; @media(--mobile) { grid-row: auto; }

classes.label: eg-bl-autor-nombre
classes.css: font-family: var(--eg-sora); font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--eg-tinta);

classes.label: eg-bl-autor-texto
classes.css: font-family: var(--eg-sora); font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--eg-gris);

classes.label: eg-bl-ar-titulo
classes.css: font-size: clamp(2.375rem, 5vw, 4.25rem); line-height: 1.04; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.035em; color: var(--eg-papel); max-width: 18ch;

classes.label: eg-bl-rejilla
classes.css: display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); grid-template-rows: auto; gap: 2.75rem 1.5rem; padding: 0; @media(--tablet) { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); } @media(--mobile) { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 2.25rem; }

classes.label: eg-bl-card
classes.css: display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0; padding: 0; height: 100%;

classes.label: eg-bl-card-media
classes.css: position: relative; display: block; aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; border-radius: 1.125rem; overflow: hidden; padding: 0; background-color: var(--eg-niebla);

classes.label: eg-bl-card-meta
classes.css: display: flex; flex-direction: row; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem 1rem; padding: 0;

classes.label: eg-bl-card-titulo
classes.css: font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1.25; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.015em; color: var(--eg-tinta);

classes.label: eg-paginacion
classes.css: display: flex; flex-direction: row; justify-content: center; gap: 0.75rem; margin-top: 3.5rem;
